name: Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd. provides securities market trading system software and securities information services in China and internationally. Its software products include market analysis system, securities trading system, intelligent service system, etc. The company also provides software maintenance services, such as software maintenance and upgrades, emergency support, irregular return visits, technical consultation, technical training, etc. In addition, it offers securities information services comprising authorized market information and financial data services for institutional or individual customers. Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
